note: DOCUMENTED EXAMPLE (not a real override): shows the rule shape — a domain, selectors to strip, an optional keep selector and title selector. Replace or extend with real per-site facts as they are learned; a rule that matches nothing is reported as rotted by wiki_site_rules.py apply.
Reference articles: keep the article body, strip edit-section links, navigation boxes, the table of contents and the reference list chrome; the headline is the page title.
Documentation pages: the main element carries the text; the Sphinx sidebar duplicates the navigation and is stripped.
DOCUMENTED EXAMPLE for a news-shaped site: the story body is a classed div (not an <article> element), the headline is an h2, and share/comment/related rails plus a paywall banner are chrome.
